changesApplied.changeMade: Added GITHUB_TOKEN format validation (ghp_* or github_pat_*) before attempting gh auth login. Added GH_AUTHENTICATED environment variable export to track authentication status. Removed silent error suppression while keeping container startup functional.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces early validation of token format to prevent silent failures. Provides clear error messages when token is invalid. Tracks authentication status for downstream consumers.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - only affects startup sequence. Backward compatible (containers still start). Improves observability and debugging.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added new helper function checkGhAuthenticated() that runs 'gh auth status' to verify authentication state.
changesApplied.reason: Provides programmatic way to check gh CLI authentication before attempting PR operations. Enables fail-fast behavior with clear error messages.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero blast radius - new function, no consumers yet until next change applied.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added authentication check before attempting PR creation. Calls checkGhAuthenticated() and throws descriptive error if not authenticated, instructing user to set valid GITHUB_TOKEN.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces authentication validation before gh pr create. Prevents HTTP 401 errors by failing early with actionable error message. Directly addresses ISSUE_1 from trace analysis.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Medium blast radius - affects all PR creation workflows. Breaking change for unauthenticated environments but prevents silent failures. Improves user experience with clear error messages.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added input validation function for git branch names. Validates against git rules: no special characters (\?*[]~^: @), no '..' or '@{', no leading '-', no trailing './', max 255 chars.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents command injection and git errors from malformed branch names. Addresses ISSUE_3 from trace analysis. Improves security posture.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero blast radius initially - new function. Will affect branch creation when integrated.

changesApplied.changeMade: Integrated validateBranchName() call at start of createBranch(). Validates input before any git operations.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces branch name validation on all branch creation operations. Prevents injection attacks and git errors.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - validation runs early, fails fast with clear error. Backward compatible for valid branch names.

changesApplied.changeMade: Added commit message sanitization function. Removes control characters (except newline/tab), limits to 50000 chars, ensures trailing newline.
changesApplied.reason: Prevents metadata injection and git history pollution. Addresses ISSUE_4 from trace analysis. Improves security and data integrity.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Zero blast radius initially - new function. Will affect commit creation when integrated.

changesApplied.changeMade: Integrated sanitizeCommitMessage() to sanitize commit message before git commit. Protects against malformed messages.
changesApplied.reason: Enforces commit message sanitization on all commits. Prevents injection and ensures clean git history.
changesApplied.impactAnalysis: Low blast radius - sanitization is transparent for normal messages. Improves security without breaking existing workflows.

infrastructureChangesRequired.reason: Code changes enforce authentication, but infrastructure must provide valid token. Without this, all PR operations remain blocked.
